_doc: Labelled pages for measuring whether a small local model can supply RUBRIC Depth. Each label is the Depth the MAINTAINER assigns to the LINKED PAGE. Labels sourced from reviews already written (the PR/issue is named) or from reading the page on the date given. Deliberately NOT the merge decision: several 2026 holds were about external recognition, which is a different dimension. Band coverage is uneven — only three cases at Depth 0, because this list does not collect marketing pages and the only ones available are submissions that were rejected. The flag under test is `presents_original_findings`, whose ground truth here is expected_depth == 3. Cases marked HARD CASE exist to separate that judgement from surface cues: original research wrapped in product CTAs (positive), and expert analysis of somebody else's discovery (negative).
